svg.title: Idempotency and execution identity: submission, actions and takeover
svg.desc: Time runs downward. Solid arrows are calls; dashed arrows are returns. Frames identify parallel and alternative branches.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Idempotency and execution identity: submission, actions and takeover

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Time runs downward · solid calls / dashed returns

text.tspan: Assistant / Console

text.tspan: Harness / Worker

g.data-label: 01 Submission and ownership: values are illustrative; Harness spans different workers before and after takeover.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: 01 Submission and ownership: values are illustrative; Harness spans different workers before and after takeover.

g.data-label: Epoch expresses the task generation; token identifies the current owner. Both validate task progress.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Epoch expresses the task generation; token identifies the current owner. Both
validate task progress.

g.data-label: Device fences increase across tasks without reset. Driver checks fence, task_id and epoch together.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Device fences increase across tasks without reset. Driver checks fence, task_id and epoch together.

g.data-label: 02 Planning, observation and actions: stages, invocations, observations and operations have distinct identities.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: 02 Planning, observation and actions: stages, invocations, observations and operations have distinct identities.

g.data-label: Operation IDs link intent, receipt and lookup. Repeated IDs do not execute again; conflicting payloads fail.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Operation IDs link intent, receipt and lookup. Repeated IDs do not execute again; conflicting payloads fail.

g.data-label: 03 Interrupted before P2 reaches T2. Intent alone cannot establish whether execution occurred.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: 03 Interrupted before P2 reaches T2. Intent alone cannot establish whether execution occurred.

g.data-label: Never replay P2 automatically. A new model-chosen operation gets a new ID and separate accounting.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Never replay P2 automatically. A new model-chosen operation gets a new ID and separate accounting.
